nApi caramaH anumAnaM pramARaM na BavatIti bruvARena tvayA aSiraskavacanasyopanyAse mama mAtA banDyetivadvyAGAtApAtAt । kiYca pramARatadABAsavyavasTApanaM tatsamAnajAtIyatvAditi vadatA BavatEva “pramARAntarasAmAnyasTitiranyaDiyAM gateH । pramARAntarasadBAvaH pratizeDAcca kasyacit ॥” iti ॥ parAkrAntaYcAtra sUriBiriti granTaBUyastvaBayAduparamyate । te ca bOdDAScaturviDayA BAvanayA BagavAn budDva eka eva boDayitA taTApi bodDavyAnAM budDiBedAccAturviDyaM yaTA gato'stamarka ityukte jAracOrAnUcAnAdayaH svezwAnusAreRABisaraRaparasvaharaRasadAcaraRAdisamayaM buDyante । sarvvaM jalaDarapawalaM santaScAmI BAvA iti । na cAyamasidDo hetuH arTakriyAkAritvalakzaRasya sattvasya nIlAdikzaRAnAM pratyakzAsidDatvAt vyApakavyAvfttyA vyApyavyAvfttinyAyena vyApakakramAkramavyAvfttAvakzaRikAt sattvavyAvftteH sidDatvAcca । taccArTakriyAkAritvaM kramAkramAByAM vyAptaM na ca kramAkramAByAmanyaH prakAraH samasti parasparaviroDe hi na prakArAntarasTitiH । nEkatApi virudDAnAmuktimAtraviroData iti nyAyena vyAGAtasyodBawatvAt । tO ca kramAkramO sTAyinaH sakASAdvyAvarttamAnO arTakriyAmapi vyAvarttayantO kzaRikatvapakza eva sattvaM vyavasTApayata iti sidDam । nanvakzaRikasyArTakriyAkAritvaM kiM na syAditi cet tadayuktaM vikalpAsahatvAt taTA hi varttamAnArTakriyAkaraRakAle atItAnAgatayoH kimarTakriyayoH sTAyinaH sAmarTyamasti no vA । Adye tayoranirAkaraRaprasaNgaH samarTasya kzepAyogAt yat yadA yatkaraRasamarTaM tat tadA tatkarotyeva yaTA sAmagrI svakAryyaM samarTaScAyaM BAva iti prasaNgAnumAnAcca । dvitIye'pi kadApi na kuryyAt sAmarTyamAtrAnubanDitvAdarTakriyAkAritvasya yat yadA yanna karoti tat tadA tatrAsamarTaM yaTA hi SilASakalamaNkure na cEza varttamAnArTakriyAkaraRakAle vfttavarttizya mARe arTakriye karotIti tadviparyyayAcca । nanu kramavatsahakArilABAt sTAyinaH atItAnAgatayoH krameRa kramaRamupapadyate iti cet tatredaM BavAn pfzwo vyAcazwAM sahakAriRaH kiM BAvasyopakurvvanti na vA na cet nApekzaRIyAste akiYcit kurvvatAM tezAM tAdAtmyAyogAt । upakArakatvapakze so'yamupakAraH kiM BAvAdBidyate na vA Bedapakze AgantukasyEva tasya kAraRatvaM syAt na BAvasyAkzaRikasya AgantukAtiSayAnvayavyatirekAnuviDAyitvAt । kAryyasya । taduktam । “varzAtapAByAM kiM vyomnaScarmmaRyasti tayoH Palam । carmmopamaScet so'nityaH KatulyaScedasatPalaH ॥” iti । aTa BAvastEH sahakAriBiH sahEva kAryyaM karotIti svaBAva iti cet aNga tarhi sahakAriRo na jahyAt pratyuta palAyamAnAnapi gale pASena badDvA kftyaM kAryyaM kuryyAt svaBAvasyAnapAyAt । kiYca sahakArijanyo'tiSayaH kimatiSayAntaramAraBate na vA uBayaTApi prAguktadUzaRapAzARavarzaRaprasaNgaH । atiSayAntarAramBapakze bahumuKAnavasTAdOsTyamapi syAt atiSaye janayitavye sahakAryyantarApekzAyAM tatparamparApAta ityekAnavasTA''sTeyA taTAhi sahakAriBiH salilapavanAdiBiH padArTasArTErADIyamAne bIjasyAtiSaye bIjamutpAdakamaByupeyam aparaTA tadaBAve'pyatiSayaH prAdurBavet bIjaYcAtiSayamAdaDAnaM sahakArisApekzamevADatte anyaTA sarvvadopakArApattO aNkurasyApi sadodayaH prasajyeta । tasmAdatiSayArTamapekzamAREH sahakAriBiratiSayAntaramADeyaM bIje tasminnapyupakAre pUrvvanyAyena sahakArisApekzasya bIjasya janakatve sahakArisampAdyabIjagatAtiSayAnavasTA praTamA vyavasTitA । aTopakAraH kAryyArTamapekzamARo'pi bIjAdinirapekzaM kAryyaM janayati tatsApekzo vA । praTame bIjAderahetutvamApatet । dbitIye apekzyamARena bIjAdinA upakAre atiSaya ADeyaH evaM tatra tatrApIti bIjAdijanyAtiSayanizWAtiSayaparamparApAta iti dvitIyAnavasTA sTirA Bavet । evamapekzyamARenopakAreRa bIjAdO DarmmiRyupakArAntaramADeyamityupakArADeyabIjAtiSayASrayAtiSayaparamparApAta iti tftIyAnavasTA duravasTA syAt । aTa BAvAdaBinno'tiSayaH sahakAriBirADIyata ityaByupagamyate tahi prAcIno BAvo'natiSayAtmA nivfttaH anyaScAtiSayAtmA kurvvadrUpAdipadavedanIyA jAyata iti PalitaM mamApi manoraTadrumeRa । tasmAdakzaRikasyArTakriyA durGawA nApyakrameRa Gawate vikalpAsahatvAt । taTAhi yugapatasakalakAryyakaraRasamarTaH sa BAvastaduttarakAlamanuvarttate na vA । praTame tatkAlavat kAlAntare'pri tAvat kAryyakAraRamApatet । dbitIye sTAyitvavfttyASA mUzikaBakzitabIjAdAvaNkurAdijananaprArTanAmanuharet । yad virudDaDarmmADyastaM tannAnA yaTA SItozRe । virudDaDarmmADyastaScAyamiti jalaDare pratibanDasidDiH । na cAyamasidDo hetuH sTAyini kAlaBedena sAmarTyAsAmarTyayoH prasaNgatadviparyyayasidDatvAttatrAsAmaTyasADakO prasaNgatadviparyyayO prAguktO sAmarTyasADakAvaBiDIyete yadyadA yajjananAsamarTaM tattadA tanna karoti yaTA SilASakalamaNkuram asamarTaScAyaM varttamAnArTakriyAkaraRakAle atItAnAgatayoraTakriyayoriti prasaNgaH yadyadA yat karoti tattadA tatra samarTaM yaTA sAmagrI svakAryye karoti cAyamatItAnAgatakAle tatkAlavarttinyAvarTakriye BAva iti prasaNgavyatyayaH viparyyayaH । tasmAdvipakze kramayOgapadyavyAvfttyA vyApakAnupalamBenADigatavyatirekavyAptikaM prasaNgatadviparyyayabalAt grahItAnvayavyAptikaM sattvaM kzaRikatvapakza eva vyavasTAsyatIti sidDam । taduktaM jYAnaSriyA । “yat sattat kzaRikaM yaTA jalaDaraH santaSca BAvA amI sattASaktirihArTakarmmaRi miteH sidDezu sidDA na sA । nApyekEva viDAnyaTA parakftenApi kriyAdirBavet । dveDApi kzaRaBaNgasaNgatirataH sADye ca viSrAmyati ॥” iti ॥ na ca kaRaBakzAkzacaraRAdipakzakakzIkAreRa sattAsAmAnyayogitvameva satvamiti mantavyaM sAmAnyaviSezasamavAyAnAmasattvaprasaNgAt । na ca tatra svarUpasattAnibanDanaH sadvyavahAraH prayojakagOravApatteH anugatatvAnanugatatvavikalpaparAhateSca sarzapamahIDarAdizu vilakzaRezu kzaRezvanugatasyAkArasya maRizu sUtravadBUtakaRezu guRavaccApratiBAsanAcca । kiYca sAmAnyaM sarvvagataM svASrayasarvvagataM vA praTame sarvvavastusaNkaraprasaNgaH apasidDvAntApattiSca yataH proktaM praSastapAdena svavizayasarvvagatamiti । kiYca vidyamAne Gawe varttamAnaM sAmAnyamanyatra jAyamAnena sambaDyamAnaM tasmAdAgacCat sambaDyate anAgacCadvA Adye dravyatvApattiH dvitIye sambanDAnupapattiH । kiYca vinazwe Gawe sAmAnyamavatizWate vinaSyati sTAnAntaraM gacCati vA praTame nirADAratvApattiH dvitIye nityatvavAco yuktyayuktiH zwatIye dravyatvaprasaktiH ityAdi dUzaRagrahagrastatvAt sAmAnyamaprAmARikam । taduktam । “anyatra varttamAnasya tato'nyasTAnajanmani । tasmAdacalataH sTAnAdvfttirityatiyuktatA ॥ yatrAsO varttate BAvastena sambaDyate na tu । taddeSinaYca vyApnoti kimapyetanmahAdButam ॥ na yAti na ca tatrAsIdasti paScAnnacAMSavat । jahAti pUrvvaM nADAramaho vyasanasantatiH ॥” iti ॥ anuvfttapratyayaH kimAlambana iti cet aNga anyApohAlambana eveti santozwavyamAyuzmateti alamatiprasaNgena । sarvvasya saMsArasya duHKAtmakatvaM sarvvatIrTakarasammatam anyaTA tannivivftsUnAM tezAM tannivfttyupAye pravfttyanupapatteH । tasmAt sarvvaM duHKaM duHKamiti BAvanIyam । nanu kiMvaditi pfzwe dfzwAntaH kaTanIya iti cenmEvaM svalakzaRAnAM kzaRAnAM kzaRikatayA sAlakzaRyABAvAt nEtena sadfSamaparamiti vaktumaSakyatvAt । tataH svalakzaRaM svalakzaRamiti BAvanIyam evaM SUnyaM SUnyamityapi BAvanIyaM svapne jAgaraRe ca na mayA dfzwamidaM rajatAdIti viSizwanizeDasyopalamBAt । yadi dfzwaM sat tadA tadviSizwasya darSanasyedantAyA aDizWAnasya
